inputVariables.message: Why was I charged £3.50 for using an ATM abroad?

evaluationSamples.referenceResponse: That £3.50 is our non-sterling cash withdrawal fee, which applies each time you take cash out in a currency other than GBP. It's disclosed in your account tariff under 'International transactions'. Let me know if you'd like me to walk through cheaper options for future trips.

inputVariables.message: How do I set up a standing order to my landlord for £950 on the 1st of every month?

evaluationSamples.referenceResponse: In the app, go to Payments → Standing Orders → New, enter your landlord's account details, set the amount to £950 and the frequency to monthly starting on the 1st. You'll get a confirmation notification once it's scheduled — the first payment will leave your account on the next 1st of the month.
